title: Customer Success Churn Review
summary: Discussion covered Churn, Activation, Onboarding, Pricing. The team reached 2 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Use first-30-day activation as a primary churn signal
Trigger intervention when fewer than two workflows are live by day 14

action_items.task: Use first-30-day activation as a primary churn signal
Trigger intervention when fewer than two workflows are live by day 14

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on Churn, Activation, Onboarding.

transcript.speaker: Ananya Bose
transcript.text: A timed intervention will work better than asking CSMs to manually watch every account.

transcript.speaker: Neha Kulkarni
transcript.text: The data is strong enough to test this, but I want the success metric defined before launch.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: The product problem is not lack of ideas. It is choosing the smallest set that creates repeat value.

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we use first-30-day activation as a primary churn signal.

transcript.speaker: Ananya Bose
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we trigger intervention when fewer than two workflows are live by day 14.

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on trigger intervention when fewer than two workflows are live by day 14. Let's capture owners and move.
